title: swampie/nf-sleep pipeline parameters
description: Sleep pipeline used as a QA fixture. Profiles define only `timeout`, so the other params exercise the PLAT-6554 case where the incoming profile does not define the parameter.

sleep_options.title: Sleep options
sleep_options.description: Controls how long and how many times the pipeline sleeps.

timeout.description: Seconds each task sleeps. DEFINED BY the rootOnlyAlpha/rootOnlyBeta profiles — a profile value is expected to win here (PLAT-6554 case 1, by design).

times.description: Number of tasks to run. NOT defined by any profile — a user-typed value must survive a re-fetch (PLAT-6554 case 2).

forks.description: Max parallel tasks. NOT defined by any profile (PLAT-6554 case 2).

outdir.description: Output directory. NOT defined by any profile (PLAT-6554 case 2).
